title: Configuration, Structured Logging & Observability
objectives: Log structured events with request IDs
Expose the metrics and health endpoints operations needs

examples.name: obs.js

exercise.prompt: Classify config sources: "PORT in env" (environment), "defaults in code" (defaults), "secrets from a secret manager" (secret store), "DB URL in the git repo" (never).
hints: 12-factor: config lives in the environment; code holds only defaults.
Git history is forever — secrets never belong there.

questions.prompt: A requestId middleware exists so that…
options: every log line of one request can be found together
questions.explanation: Correlation is the difference between 10 minutes and 10 hours of diagnosis.

questions.prompt: Structured (JSON) logs beat text logs in production because…
options: they are queryable: filter by level, route, latency, requestId
questions.explanation: Operators grep/alert on fields; prose logs defeat that.
